results.name: module exposes Stage 59 API
basic answer-key exact matching and score
answer comparison is case-insensitive
outer punctuation and extra spaces are normalized
valid alternative answer variants use double-pipe separator
alternative variants do not accept unlisted spelling
internal punctuation is not discarded
spelling is not autocorrected
blank response is wrong and tracked as blank
omitted trailing learner responses are padded as blanks
too many learner answer rows are rejected
empty or blank answer key row is rejected
answer key question count is capped at 40
custom question marks affect weighted raw score
marks default to one per question
marks count mismatch is rejected
marks must be whole numbers 1 through 4
unordered multi-selection can ignore order when requested
multi-selection remains order-sensitive by default
full-width text is Unicode-normalized
multiple marks show question and mark counts separately
correct mark percentage is rounded to two decimals
writing Task 1 requires a real response and records 150-word target
writing below 150 words is flagged but not mathematically penalized
Task 2 target is 250 words and remains advisory
writing text minimum prevents blank/no-evidence review
four criterion ratings are equally averaged
criterion ratings accept half-band steps
criterion ratings reject quarter-band increments
all four criteria are required
every criterion needs a specific evidence note
feedback source is validated per criterion
self-review source is explicitly labelled as unverified
outside feedback sources are labelled reported but not authenticated
speaking cannot be scored without a saved audio ID
speaking cannot use transcript as substitute for replay confirmation
speaking score requires actual audio ID and review attestation
Task 1 plus twice Task 2 weighting is calculated correctly
writing combined index refuses a missing task score
writing combined index refuses non-numeric task score
descriptor guides exist for Writing Task 1, Task 2 and Speaking
legacy Stage 58 score data remains a separate record format
Stage 58 accuracy adapter receives 0–1 ratio for new raw results

limitations: Answer-key source is user-declared and is not authenticated by the offline app.
Writing and Speaking criterion ratings are human-entered formative reviews, not automatic examiner grades.
The app does not convert raw Reading/Listening marks to a generic band because test-version conversions can vary.
